# Welcome to My Learning Journey

This website documents my path through **Linux system administration**, **Docker containerization**, **DevOps practices**, and **Cybersecurity/CTF challenges**.

## Learning Path

### Phase 1: Linux Fundamentals ✅

User management, permissions, networking, shell scripting

### Phase 2: Containerization ✅

Docker basics, volumes, networks, troubleshooting

### Phase 3: DevOps Practices 🔄

Ansible, Cron, MariaDB, CI/CD basics — *In Progress (50%)*

### Phase 4: Security Fundamentals 🔄

CTF basics, forensics, web security, HTB Academy — *In Progress*

### Phase 5: Advanced Topics ⏳

Kubernetes, advanced networking, penetration testing
